result.response:
The task in `cases/a02` is complete according to the [task specification](file:///C:/Users/hi/src/personal_repos/TasteForge/evals/runs/2026-11-01-antigravity-inventory/cases/a02/task.md) and the TasteForge design workflow.

### Implementation Summary
- **UX & Responsive Structure**: Implemented the Split Workspace pattern documented in [UX_PLAN.md](file:///C:/Users/hi/src/personal_repos/TasteForge/evals/runs/2026-11-01-antigravity-inventory/cases/a02/UX_PLAN.md). On wide viewports, inventory scanning and item inspection appear side-by-side. On narrow screens, items adapt into compact cards that retain full list context above the active inspector, with an explicit `back-to-list` return control.
- **Fixture & Disclosures**: Embedded [fixture.json](file:///C:/Users/hi/src/personal_repos/TasteForge/evals/runs/2026-11-01-antigravity-inventory/cases/a02/fixture.json) unchanged into [app.js](file:///C:/Users/hi/src/personal_repos/TasteForge/evals/runs/2026-11-01-antigravity-inventory/cases/a02/app.js). Initial state renders all 5 items with no selection, empty search, and unselected shortage filter. Visible simulated environment disclosures display snapshot timing and confirm local simulation.
- **Search & Shortage Filters**:
  - `data-testid="shortage-only"` filters strictly to items with `shortage > 0` (CER-204, LIN-115, CER-120), retaining LIN-115 despite incoming stock.
  - `data-testid="inventory-search"` matches case-insensitively across SKU and item name, offering a `data-testid="clear-search"` action on zero matches.
- **Inspection & Replenishment Flow**:
  - Selecting `LIN-115` (`data-testid="item-LIN-115"`) reveals all five stock metrics: available stock (2 pieces), reorder point (10 pieces), shortage (8 pieces), incoming (4 pieces), and bin location (`B-04`).
  - `data-testid="decision-quantity"` defaults to the item's shortage (8) and restricts input to positive integers between 1 and 50.
  - `data-testid="review-decision"` displays the selected item, quantity, unit, and the notice that recording places no purchase order.
  - `data-testid="edit-decision"` returns to the quantity input while preserving entered values.
  - `data-testid="save-decision"` visibly fails on first attempt with status feedback in `data-testid="decision-status"`; `data-testid="retry-decision"` succeeds on retry.
  - `data-testid="back-to-list"` retains all active search and filter states.
- **Visual Design & System Typography**: System font stack in [styles.css](file:///C:/Users/hi/src/personal_repos/TasteForge/evals/runs/2026-11-01-antigravity-inventory/cases/a02/styles.css) with explicit support for Vietnamese diacritics (`Khăn bàn Nguyễn Thị Minh Anh — Natural linen`) and accessible high-contrast tokens.

### Verification & Review
- **Static Audit**: Executed `tasteforge audit --path .` via WSL; passed with 0 errors and 0 warnings.
- **Visual Self-Review**: Generated and inspected [desktop.png](file:///C:/Users/hi/src/personal_repos/TasteForge/evals/runs/2026-11-01-antigravity-inventory/cases/a02/evidence/self-review/desktop.png) and [mobile.png](file:///C:/Users/hi/src/personal_repos/TasteForge/evals/runs/2026-11-01-antigravity-inventory/cases/a02/evidence/self-review/mobile.png) using `preview.mjs`. Refined narrow-viewport card metrics and header spacing in the single review iteration.
- Complete documentation and audit logs are saved in [implementation-notes.md](file:///C:/Users/hi/src/personal_repos/TasteForge/evals/runs/2026-11-01-antigravity-inventory/cases/a02/implementation-notes.md).
